B0500.title: Driver Power Window Circuit Malfunction
B0500.description: The driver power window motor or switch circuit has reported a fault. The window may not operate.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0510.title: Driver Door Open Switch
B0510.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver door open (jamb) switch. The door open state cannot be reliably read — affects interior light, seat belt warning, and remote start interlocks.

causes.label: Door jamb switch stuck or corroded

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0520.title: Passenger Door Open Switch
B0520.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the passenger door open (jamb) switch. Same fault profile as B0510 but for the passenger door.

causes.label: Door jamb switch stuck or corroded

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired
